Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached are our redlines to the MSA and the supporting logo guidelines Ferrum asked for. Two quick asks where we need alignment before we can proceed to signature:

1) Embargo window: Section 9.4 currently allows public announcements at "Customer's discretion". For both parties' go-to-market planning we prefer a short, mutual embargo (7 calendar days) after a joint press release is issued, with a carve-out allowing Ferrum to issue a case study quote earlier if pre-approved in writing. Can you confirm Ferrum is comfortable with that?

2) Reference & logo use: The redline narrows the reference permission to "case study quotes and logo on corporate website" and adds a short approval process (48 business hours). Ferrum previously requested an evergreen reference clause; if you need that, please let us know what approval SLAs you can tolerate.

I cc'd Dev and Karthik so they can weigh in on any legal or product constraints.

Attachments: MSA_redlines_20250722.docx (tracked changes), Ferrum_Logo_Guidelines.pdf

- You confirm whether Ferrum accepts the 7-day mutual embargo or proposes a different window.
- If the reference clause needs to be evergreen, share suggested language or a bullet list of required approvals so we can draft a narrow exception.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if that's easier.

Monica / Karthik —

I reviewed Ferrum's initial reply and Contracts' likely redlines. A couple internal notes for our position:

- Embargo: 7 days mutual is fine. We should accept Ferrum's carve-out for a pre-approved quote but push for a requirement that any early quote be limited to a single sentence and cannot include performance metrics. This reduces risk of an inadvertent technical claim.

- Evergreen references: We should avoid an absolute evergreen right without a narrow approval mechanism. Karthik, recommend we offer "reference listing" in corporate materials plus two co-marketing items per year (joint webinar or case study) that require approval. For logo usage, require adherence to our brand guidelines (see Ferrum_Logo_Guidelines.pdf) and retain final sign-off on anything that uses Redwood trade dress.

- Approval SLAs: 48 business hours is tight; propose 3 business days for approvals that require legal review, 48 hours for purely marketing copy. That split will help avoid missed deadlines.

I'll attach a short redline bundle for the publicity section and a suggested clause for the embargo carve-out (limiting quote length and pre-approval mechanics). If you want, I can drop these into the MSA tracked changes and send back.

Thanks for the quick reply. We reviewed Contracts' likely asks and Dev sent suggested language (attached). Summary of our proposed compromise:

• Mutual embargo of 7 calendar days after joint release; Ferrum may include a single-sentence client quote in a Ferrum-authored press release provided Ferrum shares the draft 5 business days in advance and Redwood provides sign-off (marketing review only) within 3 business days.

• Reference rights: Redwood may list Ferrum as a customer and use the Ferrum logo in corporate materials. For any co-branded asset (case studies, joint webinars, product screenshots) Ferrum must provide materials for approval; approvals that require legal review get 3 business days, marketing-only approvals 48 business hours.

• Logo use: Follow the attached Ferrum_Logo_Guidelines.pdf; Redwood will not alter Ferrum trade dress without written permission.

If that sounds reasonable, can Contracts confirm acceptance in their redlines? If Ferrum needs evergreen language beyond the above, please flag specific text and we'll escalate to legal.
